title: docs(skills): object colour by business family; the data skill teaches showOnCreate and drops the subforms pointer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86Lu4u71hEUFsgZYL8QN9v8)_
Fixes #36628
Fixes #36611

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照技能包搭应用的 AI,给对象挑图标底色时,会照平台自己的做法按业务分组上色(人员一色、审批与工作一色……),红色只留给真正的告警,没人打开的内部对象不上色;不再被要求「同一应用里颜色不能重复」。另外 AI 会知道「新建时不问某个字段」的写法,分步表单会被指到「由动作打开的具名分步表单」。
- 为什么做:平台自己的对象已按业务家族上色(你 11-23 定稿的配色表),技能还在教相反的规则;子表单那段是「内部新建/编辑表单退役」的第二阶段收尾,第一阶段已合并。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字,不碰数据、接口和运行时;撤回这一个合并就恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:技能包属受管文件,需要 os-zhuang 在 GitHub 上批准;另有一张大的技能改版草稿(#36158)改同几份文件,两者会有文字冲突,后合的一方要合一下。

## What changes

One PR for two cards in the same files, by the seat's dispatch.

**#36628, object colour (`skills/objectstack-data`).**
- `SKILL.md`, the `color` row of the object property table. Before: "Give every object one; avoid repeats in one app". With nine palette names any app past nine objects must repeat one, and the platform's own objects are coloured by business family (PR #36605). After: group the app's objects into a few business families, one palette name each, as the platform's own objects do (people `blue`, security `purple`, approvals and work `orange`, messaging `pink`, integrations `teal`, reference data and finance `green`, audit and settings `amber`); `red` only for an object that is an alert; an object nobody opens gets none (it draws the default `gray`). No card ids in the text.
- `references/examples-objects.md`, Quick-Start Template: the `support_case` object declares `color: 'orange'` (work) beside its `icon`.
- Evals: no case in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` mentions `color`; the object-authoring cases (ids 1 and the Chinese-labels case) ask for `icon` and say nothing about colour, so they agree with the new guidance and are unchanged.

**#36611, stage 2 (stage 1 was PR #36625, merged).**
1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`: the pointer "The rendering side, `subforms` overrides included: objectstack-ui → Master-Detail Forms" drops the `subforms` clause. objectstack-ui's Form Views now says a container's `subforms` steer nothing.
2. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, Conditional Field Rules: a bullet teaching `showOnCreate: false` (off every create surface; edit, the record page and lists keep it; refused beside `required: true`). The section's opening list of where field rules apply now reads "New and Edit, named and public forms, inline master-detail grids, API writes" instead of naming "default forms, Studio-authored forms".
3. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, after the Flow Types table: a stepped form over one object that never branches is "an objectstack-ui named form view (`type: 'wizard'`) a `type: 'form'` action opens", matching `skills/README.md` since #36625.
- Evals: `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` case 4 (a branching onboarding wizard is a `screen` flow, `must_not_contain: "type: 'wizard'"`) and the trigger case still hold; no data eval teaches `subforms` or `showOnCreate`. Unchanged.

- `.changeset/36628-36611-skills-object-colour-create-forms.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

### Paid for in the same files (no ceiling changes)

| File | Tokens before → after | Ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6710 → 6706 | 6710 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 7043 → 7045 | 7045 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` | 1719 → 1724 | 1728 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` | 4188 → 4180 | 4203 |

Cuts that pay for the new text, each a restatement or a detail kept elsewhere:
- data `SKILL.md`: `namespace`, `titleFormat`, `displayNameField` and `enable` rows shortened (the `titleFormat` row keeps its refusal and lint id and points to `nameField`, whose row carries the composite-title rule; `enable` points to the next section, which lists the flags); the `user` clause of Field Type Selection (the bullet below it says the same; "Three to get right" becomes "Two"); the `multiple: true` note's "≠ junction object … array of ids" (the table rows above say both); "composite indexes" in the indexing pointer (the example above shows one); the lifecycle class list in the Quick Reference line (in `rules/lifecycle.md`); "`conditionalRequired` … REMOVED in protocol 17" shortened to "the removed alias is a parse error".
- automation `SKILL.md`: "Interactive —" and "automatically" in two Flow Types rows.

## Why

#36628: the skill taught the opposite of the platform's approved family table, and gave no reason to pick one hue over another. #36611: the data and automation skills still pointed agents at retired create/edit form overrides and routed single-object step forms to a wizard with no door named.

## Verification

Each taught sentence against `main` (`115d38788`):
- Palette names: `packages/spec/src/data/object-icon.ts:31` (`OBJECT_COLORS`); default `gray` when absent: the `color` row's default column, unchanged.
- Family colours on the platform's own objects: e.g. `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:104` (`blue`), `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-notification.object.ts:33` (`pink`); no platform object declares `red`.
- `showOnCreate`: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2934` (meaning) and `:3263` (refused beside `required: true`).
- Named wizard form an action opens; container `subforms` inert: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` § Form Views (code readings in PR #36625's Acceptance notes).

Local gates: see the Tests section below.

## Tests

No package source changed, so no package suite is owed. Prose only, no ablation.

Local gates at `b6b84c501` (tree identical to `a2598f51`), against base `115d38788`: the 51 commands `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. **46 exit 0**, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` (and `--self-test`), `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:nul-bytes`. **5 NOT MEASURED** (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: each reads built `dist/` of packages this diff does not touch, and no workspace build was run for a prose diff; CI decides): `check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/lint`), `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. One `os:check` block changed (the Quick-Start Template gains `color: 'orange'`, a member of `OBJECT_COLORS`); `check:skill-examples` is not among the derived commands and needs client builds, so it is NOT MEASURED locally; CI decides.

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap: `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` merges cleanly with `main` and with #35129, and **conflicts with #36158** (draft, router rewrite of the same two `SKILL.md` files, last pushed 2026-11-21, waiting on a maintainer decision). #36611's triage asked to land after #36158 if both are open; this PR does not wait on it while drafting. Whichever lands second carries the merge: the changes here are a handful of lines.
- The model-tier gate reads MANDATORY `claude-fable-5-2` for `skills/**`. This thread ran on Opus; the seat decides whether a Fable pass is owed before landing.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (two cards in the same files, by the seat's dispatch)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's brief, as on other fleet PRs)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
